params.body:
A design note, nothing built. Maarten sent fourteen public datasets to take into
Gentells; looking at where they would land turned up something larger than the
list.

**Nine platform adapters deliver nothing, most without an error.** TikTok's
Apify actor has ended `SUCCEEDED` with "0 succeeded, 2 failed" since 12 May and
silently took Instagram and Reddit search with it (both seed from TikTok terms).
Reddit subs 403 since 19 August. Pinterest's actor trial expired. Twitch never
had credentials. Spotify Charts is an active tier-a source row with no adapter,
because `collect.mjs` runs a hardcoded list and not the table. What arrives
today is web/RSS, six Chinese hot-ranks and YouTube; the Peer layer has not
existed for Western platforms for four months.

The note fixes an order of work:

1. **Make silence visible.** Adapters declare what they should deliver; weeks of
   nothing becomes a finding in `/api/elixir`, the road credentials and binaries
   already took. Empty is not failed; a dependent adapter names its dead
   upstream; a source row without an adapter cannot be active.
2. **Restore the Peer layer or strike it honestly**, platform by platform, with
   the decisions that cost money named by owner.
3. **A reference layer for the datasets.** Indicators that back a claim through
   ProveML, never signals. Eurostat is the pilot (commercial reuse allowed).
   **ESS is CC BY-NC-SA and cannot go into a paid product without permission.**

It also says what is deliberately not done: no dataset as signals, no new
adapter before phase 1, no quiet single-adapter fixes that leave the hole open.
params.title: Sources before more sources: a design note
